text:
mike_r: did a quick nsys on the 2xA100 dedicated pool. seeing a repeating pattern: H2D memcpy on stream 4 starts ~10-15ms before the compute kernel on stream 0, and the kernel stalls waiting for an implicit sync.
anya_k: is that memcpy coming from KV cache prefetch or from batching hostcopy?
mike_r: looks like KV prefetch. the payload sizes are small (~64KB) but frequent; pinned pool falls back to pageable for a few of them (see the blue memcpy spans).
devon_p: can you paste the waterfall snippet? curious if it's stream priority inversion or copy engine congestion.
mike_r: here — trimmed view from nsight:```
Trace: host 0
  stream 4 memcpy H2D [0.0 - 0.012]
  stream 0 kernel  (launch) [0.013 - 0.045]
  stream 4 memcpy H2D [0.050 - 0.062]
  stream 0 kernel  (launch) [0.063 - 0.095]
```
mike_r: pattern is memcpy then kernel but we see a ~1ms gap where CPU is scheduling other work -> kernel launch delayed; total end-to-end per-token latency jumps ~8-12ms when those gaps align.
perf-bot: automattic snapshot: regressed 9.8% vs baseline on tail latency for seq_len=512 batches.
anya_k: if KV prefetch runs on the same CUDA engine with default stream priorities, small H2Ds could steal the copy engine and block kernel progress. can we try moving prefetch to a lower priority stream or coalesce the prefetches?
samir_l: also check binder of pinned pool — fallback to pageable likely because pinned pool exhausted by concurrent warmups. batching heuristic currently issues hostcopy per microbatch; maybe we should aggregate hostcopies across microbatches before issuing H2D.
devon_p: quick experiment request: 1) run with prefetch coalescing enabled (single batched hostcopy per batch); 2) run with prefetch on a low-priority copy stream; 3) increase pinned pool size by +25%. capture short nsys and compare memcpy/kernels overlap.
anmike_r: queued the three captures now. will share links when done. any specific trace flags I should include?
anya_k: include `--trace=cuda,cudaRuntimeApi` and `--capture-range=cpu:begin,end` so we can align CPU scheduling gaps with CUDA events. also enable the nvtx spans for KV operations.
mike_r: thanks — added NVTX around KV prefetch and microbatch join. starting capture  — will post results in ~10m :thumbsup:
_meta_note: This Slack thread focuses on an nsight timeline where frequent KV prefetch H2D memcpys appear to preempt kernels; discussion covers batching coalescing, pinned pool exhaustion, stream priorities, and captures to reproduce and verify. Messages are short and Slack-style.
